'''Station-Star 1''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].

==History==
Station-Star 1 was the original landing station for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], making it the first direct pipeline connecting the planet to its space system. Both the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Valarian/Legends|Valarians]] reasoned that control of the station would ensure control over all of Tatooine. For this reason, the station was a constant target for both factions, and was eventually destroyed by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Even with the station in ruins, continual fighting between the Hutts and Valarians persisted.

With the loss of Station-Star 1, the [[Tatooine Space Station]] became primary space station for the system.

==Behind the scenes==
Station-Star 1 appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
